title: Agent and Chain Orchestration
summary: This module provides the core components for building and orchestrating intelligent agents and complex chains in LangChain. It enables users to define multi-step reasoning, tool usage, and conversational flows by combining language models, tools, memory, and other runnables into cohesive applications.

nodes.label: Intelligent Agents
nodes.title: Intelligent Agent Implementations
nodes.description: Components for building autonomous agents that can reason, plan, and use tools to achieve goals, managing complex, multi-step interactions. This includes various agent types like conversational, ReAct, and OpenAI function/tool calling agents.

nodes.label: Structured Chains
nodes.title: Structured Chain Implementations
nodes.description: Predefined sequences of operations that combine language models, prompts, and other components to perform specific tasks. This includes functionalities for conversational AI, document processing, structured output extraction, and routing.

nodes.label: Conversational Memory
nodes.title: Conversational Memory Management
nodes.description: Mechanisms for storing and retrieving conversational history and other state, allowing agents and chains to maintain context across turns. Includes buffer, summary, entity, and vector-backed memory types.

nodes.label: Runnable Composition
nodes.title: Composable Runnable Orchestration
nodes.description: Tools for composing and orchestrating individual runnables into complex flows, enabling dynamic configuration, input/output manipulation, and conditional logic. It forms the backbone for building flexible agent and chain architectures.

nodes.label: Language Models
nodes.title: Core Language Model Abstractions
nodes.description: The foundational interfaces for interacting with various large language models, providing text generation and understanding capabilities. These models are central to both agent reasoning and chain execution.

nodes.label: External Tools
nodes.title: Core Tool Abstractions
nodes.description: Interfaces for defining and integrating external tools that agents can use to perform actions, fetch information, or interact with the environment. Tools extend the capabilities of LLMs.

nodes.label: Prompt Templates
nodes.title: Core Prompting Abstractions
nodes.description: Abstractions for creating and managing prompts, including chat-specific and structured prompt templates, and placeholders for dynamic content. Essential for guiding LLM behavior in agents and chains.

nodes.label: Output Parsers
nodes.title: Core Output Parsing Abstractions
nodes.description: Base classes for parsing the raw string output from an LLM into structured data, such as agent actions or final answers. Crucial for interpreting LLM responses and enabling further processing.

groups.label: Orchestration Core
groups.title: Orchestration Core
groups.description: The central components responsible for defining and executing multi-step AI workflows and intelligent decision-making processes.

groups.label: Foundational Components
groups.title: Foundational Components
groups.description: Provides the underlying mechanisms for state management, context retention, and flexible composition of executable units within agents and chains.

groups.label: LLM Ecosystem Abstractions
groups.title: LLM Ecosystem Abstractions
groups.description: Core interfaces and base classes from other modules that provide the fundamental building blocks for language models, tools, prompts, and output parsing, essential for agent and chain functionality.
